properties.disease overview: Medical emergency caused by increased pressure within a closed muscle compartment (often after trauma/fracture) leading to reduced tissue perfusion, ischemia, and potential irreversible muscle/nerve damage.
properties.mechanism: Rising intracompartmental pressure (bleeding/edema within noncompliant fascia) exceeds capillary perfusion pressure → impaired microcirculation → ischemia → muscle necrosis and nerve injury; requires urgent decompression (fasciotomy).
